s: God is a True Being (the only one in the whole world)
q: In the whole world there is only one True Being; there is no second.

s: the Qazi is a one who turns men away from the world (by the Guru's favour while alive he is dead)
q: a Qazi who turneth away men from the world, And who by the Guru's favour while alive is dead

s: Brahman takes life (and then bathes)
q: The Brahman taketh life and then batheth.

s: Brahman is a one who reflects upon God (saved himself and his relations)
q: He is a Brahman who reflecteth upon God: He shall be saved himself, and shall save all his relations.

s: Jogi is ignorant of the way of union with God (the ignorant Jogi)
q: The ignorant Jogi knoweth not the way of union with God-- The whole three ruin the world.

s: Jogi is a one who knows the way to God (by the Guru's favour recognizes the One)
q: He is a Jogi who knoweth the way to God, And who by the Guru's favour only recognizeth the One.

s: Musalman is a one who cleanses his impurity
q: A Musalman is he who cleanseth his impurity.

s: woman is honoured in Spouse (if she pleases her Spouse)
q: If a woman please her Spouse, she shall be honoured in His house:

s: woman utters falsehood (without benefit)
q: If she utter falsehood it is of no avail: If she utter falsehood it is of no avail her Spouse will not look at her.

s: woman is forgotten by Spouse (without merits and false)
q: Without merits, forgotten by her Spouse, and false, painful are her nights.

s: Spouse does not look at woman (when she utters falsehood)
q: If she utter falsehood it is of no avail her Spouse will not look at her.

s: God is a Giver (ever and ever)
q: He is ever and ever the Giver.

s: world is ruined by the Qazi (together with the Brahman and Jogi)
q: The ignorant Jogi knoweth not the way of union with God-- The whole three ruin the world.

s: Death receives the deceitful person (at its gate after captivity)
q: Shall be led captive to the gate of Death, and shall then as he is led along regret lost opportunities.

s: transmigration is undergone by man (those who forget God's name despite great cleverness)
q: They who, though ever reading, forget God's name shall suffer punishment, And notwithstanding their great cleverness undergo transmigration.

s: destiny is written on the forehead (as lines that the foolish do not read)
q: The body is the paper, the mind the order written thereon, Silly man readeth not the lines of destiny on his forehead.

s: God's court contains three destinies (engraved there)
q: In God's court three destinies are engraved.

s: the counterfeit is counterfeit counterfeit (when assayed)
q: If thou put a bad coin with others, It will be found counterfeit on being assayed.

s: God is young ever young
q: My Lord is ever young; He is ever and ever the Giver.
